welcome.title: Welcome to Eleva Diary
welcome.subtitle: Your personal bladder diary
welcome.description: Write down your bathroom visits, drinks and any leaks. Your diary stays on your phone.

track.title: Easy Logging
track.subtitle: Simple and quick
track.description: Log bathroom visits, drinks and leaks in a few taps. Your streak shows how many days in a row you've logged.

share.title: Share Your Diary
share.subtitle: See your totals
share.description: See daily totals and simple charts of what you logged, and export your diary as a PDF, CSV or JSON file to share if you choose.

onboarding.acceptance: By continuing, you accept the {{terms}}. See how your data is handled in the {{privacy}}.

termsUpdate.body: Please read the Terms of Use and tap Accept to accept them.
termsUpdate.keepUsing: You can keep using your diary in the meantime, and you can delete your data at any time with Clear All Data in Settings.

disclaimer.text: Eleva Diary is a personal diary. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition. Talk to a health professional about your symptoms.
